events.title: Reveria: Act 1 demo out now!
events.summary: Greetings, adventurer!Assemble your party, the time has come. The demo for Reveria: Act 1 is now live! Dive into the wilderness of Reveria's Western District in this free demo that covers the first couple quests and first dungeons of the game. The demo gives access to the Human and Elf races, and to the Paladin, Rogue, Warrior, and Wizard classes.
